commit_id.description: ID of the roadmap commit that dispatched this task, when the task was created by the Commit Dispatcher. Tasks created outside that flow may omit this field.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must reach a terminal state before this task may start.

owner.description: agent_id of the agent that currently owns this task's target_paths, e.g. Builder #1. Used to detect/prevent concurrent modification by a different agent (see project/permission.schema.json for filesystem-level access, separate from this logical ownership).

workflow_id.description: ID of the project/workflow.schema.json definition governing this task's execution, if any.

workflow_state.description: Current state name within that workflow's own `states` list (project/workflow.schema.json). This is the fine-grained, workflow-specific lifecycle position (e.g. 'building', 'awaiting_review') and is the source of truth for 'where is this task in its pipeline'. `status` below is intentionally coarse and workflow-agnostic — it must never be used to infer workflow_state, and vice versa.

status.description: Coarse, workflow-agnostic lifecycle bucket. Any workflow (whatever states it defines) maps onto exactly one of these at a time. Use workflow_state for pipeline-specific detail.

blocked_reason.description: Required in practice when status = 'blocked' (e.g. 'waiting on TASK-088', 'resource owned by another task').
